defs.def: a particular situation or a situation of a particular type 具体情况；事例；实例

ex.s: In the experiment, Goffin’s cockatoos were able to select the right tool for the job, in most cases, by visual recognition alone.

ex.t: 在另一种情况下，她拿了30块。

ex.t: 理想情况下，历史会把文本和实物结合起来，本书的一些章节能够做到这一点，但在许多情况下我们根本做不到。

ex.t: 在皇帝的情况下，该礼节要求人把头触地。

defs.def: the true situation 实情；事实
a situation that relates to a particular person or thing 特殊情况

ex.s: Eyeing these headwinds, plastic-bag makers are hiring scientists like Stein to make the case that their products are not as bad for the planet as most people assume.
ex.t: 面对这些阻力，塑料袋制造商正在聘请像斯坦这样的科学家来论证他们的产品对地球的危害并不像大多数人认为的那么大。

defs.def: a matter that is being officially investigated, especially by the police （尤指警方）侦查的案情，调查的案件

ex.s: A case in point is that some large, age-old lakes shrank dramatically in what appears to have been a matter of months.
ex.t: 一个恰当的例子是，一些古老的大型湖泊在似乎是短短几个月的时间内急剧萎缩。

defs.def: a question to be decided in court 待裁决的案件
a set of facts or arguments that support one side in a trial, a discussion, etc. （在审判、讨论等中支持一方的）论据，理由

ex.s: When the polluting industries argue that we’ve lost the battle to control carbon pollution and have no choice but to adapt, it’s a nonsense designed to make the case for business as usual.
ex.t: 当污染行业争辩说我们在控制碳排放的战斗中已经失败，除了适应别无选择时，这是一种旨在为一切照旧的商业模式制造理由的 nonsense。

ex.s: The goal of this book is to make the case for digital minimalism, including a detailed exploration of what it asks and why it works, and then to teach you how to adopt this philosophy if you decide it’s right for you.
ex.t: 这本书的目标是论证数字极简主义，包括详细探讨它的要求及其为何有效，然后教你如何采纳这一理念——如果你认定它适合你的话。

defs.def: a container or covering used to protect or store things; a container with its contents or the amount that it contains 常构成复合词
the fact of sb having a disease or an injury; a person suffering from a disease or an injury 病例；病案；病人；伤员

ex.s: Already this year, 115 measles cases have been reported in the USA, compared with 189 for all of last year.
ex.t: 今年到目前为止，美国已报告115例麻疹病例，而去年全年为189例。

ex.s: a small number of measles cases can start a dangerous trend
ex.t: 少量麻疹病例就可能引发一个危险趋势。

ex.s: Alvaro Luna, a professor of electrical engineering, said that the system is innovative in so far as it allows for recycled energy to be redirected to specific local uses — in this case powering electric cars parked nearby.

ex.s: In some cases, local produce might have used more energy and produced more greenhouse gases than produce grown a long way away - even taking into account its transport.
